title: LADM LA_SpatialUnit Profile (JSON-FG)
description: Implementation of LADM Spatial Unit package extending LA_Feature (JSON-FG 1.0.0 + VersionedObject). Exactly one spatial representation is active per instance, declared by 'representationType': geometrical (place geometry), topological (boundary face string references), or textual (legal description).

allOf.$comment: 2. CONSTRAINTS & EXTENSIONS: Spatial Unit specific properties

featureType.description: Discriminator identifying this as a Cadastral Spatial Unit

coordRefSys.description: Default CRS for the 'place' geometry (e.g., EPSG:3765). Required when representationType is 'geometrical'.

suID.description: LADM domain identifier (Namespace + LocalId). Complements the root-level 'id' (UUID/URI).

dimension.description: LA_DimensionType — declared spatial dimensionality of this unit

representationType.description: Declares how this spatial unit's extent is expressed. Exactly one representation is active per instance. 'geometrical': a coordinate-based geometry in 'place'; 'topological': closed boundary expressed as references to LA_BoundaryFaceString features; 'textual': legal/metes-and-bounds description.

area.description: LA_AreaValue [0..*]. Required for 2D and 3D spatial units regardless of representation type.

referencePoint.description: Representative point inside the spatial unit (for labelling / centroid queries). Always in native CRS.

landUse.description: Reference to Land Use CodeList (SKOS concept via theme pattern)

boundaryFaceStrings.description: References to LA_BoundaryFaceString features whose directed curves together form the closed boundary of this spatial unit. Required when representationType is 'topological'. The ordering and direction of curves must form a closed ring.

legalDescription.description: Textual/legal description of the spatial unit's extent (metes-and-bounds, parcel reference, etc.). Required when representationType is 'textual'.

lifespanVersion.description: System/database lifespan of this spatial unit version (LADM beginLifespanVersion / endLifespanVersion).

allOf.$comment: --- RULE: geometrical → place required; dimension constrains allowed geometry types ---
2D dimension: only flat geometry types permitted
3D dimension: only volumetric geometry types permitted
--- RULE: topological → place must be null/absent; boundaryFaceStrings required ---
--- RULE: textual → place must be null/absent; legalDescription required ---
--- RULE: 2D/3D AREA REQUIREMENT (applies to all representation types) ---

LA_AreaValue.description: Structured area measurement with unit of measure referenced via CodeListRef (QUDT or OGC Units registry)

uom.description: Unit of measure via CodeListRef. Recommended scheme: QUDT (https://qudt.org/vocab/unit/) or OGC Units of Measure (https://www.opengis.net/def/uom/). Common units: http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M2, http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/HectoARE, http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloM2
